thread:
sophia: quick heads-up / prototyping an automatic fallback flow that can do staged handbacks. want ops + ux + platform feedback. :wave:
nate: what's the operator surface for seeing staged steps? a timeline?
leah: timeline + per-step sample + reason. e.g. Step 1 -> 10% traffic -> reason: latency_spike. show small sample set (3) per step.
kevin: backend note: policy should include explicit steps and a trigger_window_id so telemetry can replay. sample policy snippet:
`{"mode":"staged-fallback", "steps":[10,50,100], "trigger":{"type":"error_rate","pct":5}, "trigger_window":"w_20240601_03"}`
ops-bot: Alert: staged fallback started on /summarize (policy=pf_42) at 2024-06-01T03:12:10Z (trigger_window=w_20240601_03).
sophia: good. need audit rules: immutable record per step with trigger_window, policy_snapshot, sample_refs.
leah: privacy: default sample is first_n_non_pii=3. show shield icon in UI when redacted.
ux-bot: UX tweak: timeline shows bars for each step with hover: metrics delta + link to samples. add a compact "collapse" state for operator inbox.
nate: edge-case: step fails to apply (quota or model OOM). how do we show failure and rollback plan?
kevin: emit events: step_attempt, step_success, step_failure with failure_reason. UI should show failure_reason on the timeline and a single-click roll-forward or rollback action (role-gated).
sophia: plan: kevin will add telemetry fields, leah + ux-bot will sketch timeline & sample card, i'll draft audit schema and share with legal. reconvene tomorrow 10am. :thumbsup:
